title: CTV Frequency Management Strategy: Optimize Ad Exposure for Maximum ROI

facts.fact: The page states that brands optimizing frequency management see 35-45% better cost efficiency than unmanaged campaigns.
facts.quote: Brands that optimize frequency management see 35-45% better cost efficiency and 20-30% higher conversion rates compared to unmanaged campaigns.

facts.fact: The page states that brands optimizing frequency management see 20-30% higher conversion rates than unmanaged campaigns.

facts.fact: The page claims that 68% of CTV campaigns run without proper frequency caps, without citing a source.
facts.quote: 68% of CTV campaigns run without proper frequency caps

facts.fact: The page states that the average viewer sees the same CTV ad 8-12 times before taking action.
facts.quote: Average viewer sees the same ad 8-12 times before taking action

facts.fact: The page claims that poor frequency management wastes 25-40% of CTV budgets.
facts.quote: Poor frequency management wastes 25-40% of CTV budgets

facts.fact: The page claims brands with sophisticated frequency strategies achieve 3-5x better efficiency than those using platform defaults.
facts.quote: Brands with sophisticated frequency strategies achieve 3-5x better efficiency than those using platform defaults.

facts.fact: The page states that the average viewer watches 3.2 hours of CTV daily.
facts.quote: Average viewer watches 3.2 hours of CTV daily

facts.fact: The page states that 78% of CTV viewing happens during 3-4 consistent time blocks.
facts.quote: 78% of viewing happens during 3-4 consistent time blocks

facts.fact: The page gives 12-15 exposures as the optimal frequency for high consideration purchases such as automobiles and luxury.
facts.quote: High consideration purchases (automobiles, luxury):** 12-15 exposures optimal

facts.fact: The page gives 6-8 exposures as peak performance frequency for mid-funnel DTC categories such as supplements and skincare.
facts.quote: Mid-funnel DTC (supplements, skincare):** 6-8 exposures peak performance

facts.fact: The page gives 3-5 exposures as the point of diminishing returns for impulse purchases such as food and fashion.
facts.quote: Impulse purchases (food, fashion):** 3-5 exposures before diminishing returns

facts.fact: The page gives 15-20 exposures as the frequency for B2B products due to longer decision cycles.
facts.quote: B2B products:** 15-20 exposures due to longer decision cycles

facts.fact: The page says its own analysis of more than 500 CTV campaigns produced the frequency effectiveness curve.
facts.quote: Our analysis of 500+ CTV campaigns reveals the frequency effectiveness curve

facts.fact: The page recommends reducing frequency when CPA increases by 25% or more.
facts.quote: Performance decline:** Reduce frequency when CPA increases 25%+

facts.fact: The page recommends swapping creative when CTR drops by 30% or more.
facts.quote: Swap creative when CTR drops 30%+

facts.fact: The page recommends a starting cap of 8 exposures per 7-day window for awareness campaigns.
facts.quote: Awareness campaigns:** 8 exposures per 7-day window

facts.fact: The page recommends a starting cap of 5 exposures per 7-day window for conversion campaigns.
facts.quote: Conversion campaigns:** 5 exposures per 7-day window

facts.fact: The page recommends a starting cap of 12 exposures per 30-day window for retargeting campaigns.
facts.quote: Retargeting campaigns:** 12 exposures per 30-day window

facts.fact: The page recommends a starting cap of 6 exposures per 14-day window for brand consideration campaigns.
facts.quote: Brand consideration:** 6 exposures per 14-day window

facts.fact: The page gives an advanced configuration with a daily cap of 2 exposures maximum.
facts.quote: Daily Cap: 2 exposures maximum

facts.fact: The page gives an advanced configuration with a weekly cap of 5-8 exposures, varying by campaign objective.
facts.quote: Weekly Cap: 5-8 exposures (varies by campaign objective)

facts.fact: The page gives an advanced configuration with a monthly cap of 15-20 exposures for long-term brand building.
facts.quote: Monthly Cap: 15-20 exposures for long-term brand building

facts.fact: The page recommends a creative-level cap of 3 exposures before rotation is required.
facts.quote: Creative Level Cap: 3 exposures before rotation required

facts.fact: The page describes a reach-focused budget model that allocates 60% of budget to new audience reach with a frequency cap of 4-5.
